$comment: OpenAI directory overlay. pack-openai.mjs merges it with brand.json (display name, short description, prompts, URLs) and writes mcp.json for the ChatGPT endpoint. review.test_cases is copied from the backend repo's scripts/review/openai-review.json; review.demo_recording_url points at the walkthrough on our R2 media domain; reviewer credentials are entered in the portal.
name: makemancer

interface.longDescription:
Create images, product photos, video clips, voiceovers, music and sound effects in the conversation. Animate a product photo into a short clip, turn a portrait and a script into a talking video, or compose a jingle for an ad.

Generate and edit images with reference photos that keep a product or face consistent, then build a matching set for a campaign. Generate video from text or images with several video models, and choose native audio or finished speech for speaking shots. Narrate a script with stock voices in many languages, compose songs and instrumentals, and make sound effects. Upscale images and video and remove backgrounds.

Generations use credits from your account; results are saved to your media library. Results vary by model. You can send feedback from the conversation.
capabilities: Generate videos from text or images

positive.description: Generate a product photo from a text prompt
positive.prompt: Use Makemancer to create a square product photo of a white ceramic coffee mug on a marble counter in soft morning light.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_image once with the prompt and a 1:1 aspect ratio. The Makemancer card shows the credits held and updates itself until the image is ready (check_job is used if the model checks the status), then shows the image with a download link. No other generation tools are called.

positive.description: Remove the background of an attached photo
positive.prompt: Use Makemancer to remove the background from the attached product photo and give me a transparent PNG.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the attachment with import_chatgpt_media and passes the stored file to remove_background. The card shows the credits charged and updates itself until the transparent PNG is ready, with a download link. It does not ask the user for a public link.

positive.description: Animate a photo into a short video after checking the cost
positive.prompt: Use Makemancer to animate the attached photo into a five-second clip with a slow camera push-in. Tell me the cost before you start.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the attachment and prepares a 5-second image-to-video request with the photo as the start frame (it may call list_models or estimate_generation first). The review account renders videos in Review mode, so generate_video returns a review card with the model, settings and cost; nothing renders or is charged until the reviewer selects Generate (the account's first video is free, later ones show their credit cost). The card then updates itself and plays the clip, typically within 1-5 minutes.

positive.description: Generate a voiceover from a script line
positive.prompt: Use Makemancer to read this line in a warm, natural voice: "Fresh coffee, every morning."
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_speech with the exact words of the line; the speech model may prefix a short delivery tag such as [warm, natural]. The card shows the credits charged and plays the audio with a download link. The words themselves are not rewritten.

positive.description: Check the credit balance and recent charges
positive.prompt: How many Makemancer credits do I have left, and what did my last generation cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls manage_account (overview or activity), which is read-only, and reports the balance and the latest generation's model, status and credits charged or refunded. It does not generate media, start a purchase or link to a checkout page.

negative.description: Plain writing request with no media
negative.prompt: Write a four-line poem about autumn leaves.
What time is it in Tokyo right now, and what's the weather like there?

negative.description: Question about how image generation works, not a request to generate
negative.prompt: Explain in simple terms how AI image generators turn a text prompt into a picture.

publication.release_notes: First release: images, product photoshoots, video clips, voiceovers, music and sound effects.
